receipt.scope: offline read-only vector-sibling linked ELF disassembly and metadata; no compiler, device, XRT, engine, lifecycle, or original-weight access
method: Every linked function enumerated from ELF symbols; exactly core, __start, _main_init, hidden_reset, hidden_chunk, hidden_finish are required. Every instruction bundle is disassembled with zeroes retained.
Direct call targets resolved to linked function entries; branches remain intra-function; normal ret lr returns are allowed.
Static SP allocations/restores matched; ELF stack metadata cross-checked wherever present. Missing core/runtime frame entries are proved from linked SP instructions.
All explicit SP-relative scalar accesses bounded at4 bytes and vector accesses conservatively bounded at128 bytes.
Known _main_init stack-derived p7 adjustment is accounted for; no unmodeled SP or stack-alias access accepted.
Acyclic complete call graph summed along deepest paths, including CRT initialization, compared with actual linker4096-byte reservation and linked SP start.
This is a static bound for ordinary compiler-generated control flow; it does not establish device execution or arithmetic accuracy.
